purpose: Identify the marginal contribution of spatial U before treating a combined Stage2-L run as semantic evidence.
scientific_question: With visual observation, route, ego state and contextual relevance held fixed, does changing only U produce the correct matched change in K and the language-facing task interpretation?

factorization.contextual_relevance: R_context = f_ORION(same-view visual evidence, route, ego state)
factorization.observation_uncertainty: U = frozen Stage1 adapter followed by the frozen task-agnostic U tokenizer
factorization.language_conditioning: Second pass receives detached frozen U tokens and trainable K bridge tokens.

matched_invariants: same route command and unmodified ORION plan
on-path and off-path U have equal peak, total mass and positive support count

bounded_diagnostic_metrics.view_shuffled_policy: Report K and answer preference for every group. Do not impose on-over-shuffled magnitude ranking unless the shuffled map is separately frozen as magnitude-matched.
required_reporting: per-event and per-view R average precision
R invariance across matched U variants
per-group U mass, U peak and support count
per-group K peak for every variant
per-variant target and counterfactual answer NLL

decision_rules.controlled_u_identifiability_fails: Repair Stage2-L interface or QA supervision; do not add epochs, Stage2-P, or closed-loop jobs.
decision_rules.controlled_u_passes_but_learned_u_extern: The semantic bridge is viable and Stage1 is the bottleneck; retain oracle/controlled U for Stage2-L development.
decision_rules.controlled_u_and_learned_u_pass_but_clos: The remaining bottleneck is Stage2-P response learning or scenario construction.
decision_rules.all_bounded_gates_pass: Authorize a new versioned multi-event pilot only; this does not itself authorize formal training or a safety claim.

unlock_requires: implementation and tests for the factorized identifiability audit
versioned frame bundles containing the exact current ORION speedometer reading
hash-bound dataset audit proving all matched invariants
a separate launch amendment for exactly one bounded run

claim_boundary: A passing v11 engineering diagnostic would show that the Stage2-L interface uses controlled spatial U counterfactually while preserving a U-independent contextual relevance map. It would not validate the learned Stage1 U, planning, closed-loop safety, or external generalization.
